schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
schemes.description: OnShift's delivery partners, transport drivers, and domestic helpers operate with zero structural retirement benefits; the 1:1 government matching contribution significantly reduces the cost of retirement planning

age.details: Age: 18 to 40 years

otherConditions: Aadhaar Card mandatory
Savings Bank Account or Jan-Dhan Account Passbook (Aadhaar-linked) with mobile number linked
Indian citizen
exclusions: Must not be an income tax payer
Must not be engaged in the organized sector
Must not hold active membership in EPFO, ESIC, or the National Pension System (NPS)

benefits: Minimum assured monthly pension of ₹3,000/- after age 60 for life

A matching contribution is provided by the Central Government on a 50:50 basis, where an equal amount to the subscriber's age-specific contribution (ranging from ₹55/- to ₹200/- per month) is credited to the pension account
If the beneficiary passes away, the spouse is entitled to a 50% family pension (family pension is applicable only to the spouse)
If a subscriber dies before age 60, the spouse can choose to continue the regular contributions or withdraw under set provisions
Exit and Withdrawal Options:
If the subscriber exits within a period of less than 10 years, only the beneficiary's share of contribution will be returned with the savings bank interest rate

If exiting after a period of 10 years or more but before the age of 60, the beneficiary's share of contribution along with accumulated interest as actually earned by the fund or at the savings bank interest rate (whichever is higher) will be returned
documents: Savings Bank Account Passbook / Jan-Dhan Account Passbook (Aadhaar-linked)
schemes.officialSource: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
schemes.description: Highly beneficial for gig and platform workers who want flexible options for retirement planning, allowing them to choose from five different pension tiers based on average earnings
targetWorkerTypes: and workers in the unorganised sector

age.details: Age of joining: Minimum age of joining APY is 18 years and maximum is 40 years

otherConditions: Resident of India
Subscriber must hold an active savings bank or post office savings bank account and provide consent for auto-debit
exclusions: Effective October 1, 2022, any citizen who is or has been an income taxpayer shall not be eligible to join APY

benefits: Guaranteed minimum pension of ₹1,000/-, ₹2,000/-, ₹3,000/-, ₹4,000/-, or ₹5,000/- per month after the age of 60 years until death, based on age at entry and contribution amount (contributions range from ₹42 to ₹210/month for age 18 entry, and ₹291 to ₹1,454/month for age 40 entry)
After the subscriber's demise, the spouse of the subscriber shall be entitled to receive the same pension amount until death
After the demise of both the subscriber and the spouse, the nominee of the subscriber shall be entitled to receive the pension wealth accumulated till the subscriber's age of 60 years
Contributions are eligible for tax benefits under Section 80CCD(1) / Section 80CCD of the Income Tax Act

In case of death of the subscriber before 60 years, the spouse can continue contributions in the APY account in the spouse's name or the entire accumulated pension corpus will be returned to the spouse/nominee
documents: KYC details (auto-fetched from the active Bank/Post Office Savings account)
and APY Subscriber Registration Form (Aadhaar is not mandatory as of now
but savings bank account/post office account is mandatory)
schemes.officialSource: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) / Ministry of Finance, Government of India

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
schemes.description: Informal and gig workers are frequently the sole breadwinners for their households. Since life insurance coverage is often low, OnShift can promote PMJJBY as an affordable safety net costing just over ₹1 per day

age.details: Age: 18 to 50 years (completed, age nearer birthday). (Coverage valid up to age 55 subject to regular premium payments)

otherConditions: Must hold an individual savings account with a participating bank/post office and link Aadhaar-based KYC to the account
Must provide consent for annual auto-debit
Eligible to join through only one savings bank account, even if multiple accounts exist
NRIs having an eligible bank account in India are eligible, but claims are paid in Indian currency

benefits: One-year term life cover of ₹2,00,000 payable to the nominee upon the subscriber's death due to any cause (including natural causes, accidents, suicide, murder, or natural disasters)
Premium is ₹436/- per annum, auto-debited annually on or before May 31
Pro-rated premiums apply for delayed quarterly enrollment: ₹342 (Sept-Nov), ₹228 (Dec-Feb), and ₹114 (Mar-May)

Lien Period: For subscribers enrolling for the first time on or after June 1, 2016, insurance benefit shall not be available for death (due to any cause other than accident) occurring during the first 30 days from enrolment
schemes.officialSource: Ministry of Finance, Government of India

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
schemes.description: OnShift’s delivery partners and transport drivers face significant road hazards daily. Because PMSBY costs just ₹20 per year, this is a key recommendation to secure an accidental death/disability safety net

age.details: Age: 18 to 70 years (completed, age nearer birthday)

otherConditions: Must hold an individual savings bank account/post office account with a participating bank
Must provide consent for annual auto-debit
In case of joint account holders, all holders can join if they satisfy eligibility criteria and pay the premium
NRIs holding an eligible bank account in India are eligible (claims paid in Indian currency)
Restricted to one claim across all bank accounts
exclusions: Cover terminates on attaining 70 years of age, upon account closure, or if the account balance is insufficient

benefits: Accidental death and disability insurance cover of up to ₹2,00,000
₹2,00,000 for accidental death or total irrecoverable loss of both eyes or loss of use of both hands/feet
₹1,00,000 for total and irrecoverable loss of sight of one eye or loss of use of one hand/foot
Premium is ₹20/- per annum, auto-debited on or before June 1 of each coverage year
Covers accidental death/disability resulting from vehicular accidents, drowning, crimes, snake bites, tree falls, and natural calamities Suicide is strictly excluded
schemes.officialSource: Ministry of Finance, Government of India

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
schemes.description: Health emergencies are a major cause of debt. OnShift can integrate an eligibility check to help workers instantly discover if their families are enrolled for cashless hospital care
targetWorkerTypes: Economically deprived rural households and designated urban occupational categories

age.details: No restriction on age or family size

income.details: Excludes households earning a monthly income above ₹10,000/-

occupation: Street vendor / Cobbler / hawker / other service provider working on streets
Construction worker / Plumber / Mason / Labour / Painter / Welder / Security guard / Coolie and other head-load worker
Home-based worker / Artisan / Handicrafts worker / Tailor
Transport worker / Driver / Conductor / Helper to drivers and conductors / Cart puller / Rickshaw puller
Shop worker / Assistant / Peon in small establishment / Helper / Delivery assistant / Attendant / Waiter
otherConditions: Entitlement-based on deprivation and occupational criteria using the SECC database

Rural Beneficiaries: Must fall into at least one of six deprivation criteria (e.g. only one room with kucha walls, landless households deriving major income from manual casual labor, SC/ST, disabled member with no able-bodied adult) or automatic inclusion (destitute, manual scavengers, primitive tribal groups, legally released bonded labor)
Resident in India
exclusions: Households owning a 2, 3, or 4-wheeler, or a motorized fishing boat
Households with employees in government-managed non-agricultural enterprises
Households living in decent, solidly built houses
Households owning 5 acres or more of agricultural land
Households holding Kisan cards with a credit limit above ₹50,000/-

benefits: Cashless, paperless health cover of up to ₹5,00,000/- per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization in empanelled public and private hospitals across India
Comprehensive coverage: consultations, diagnostics, medicines, surgery, ICU, implants, food, and pre-hospitalization (3 days) and post-hospitalization (15 days) costs
Covers approximately 1,929 medical procedures; pre-existing diseases are covered from day one with no age, gender, or family size restrictions
documents: Age & Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card / PAN Card)
and Document Proof of the current status of the family (joint or nuclear) (Aadhaar card is not mandatory for availing services)
schemes.officialSource: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India

schemes.name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY)
schemes.description: OnShift’s regional workers in Maharashtra can access the expanded MJPJAY network for cashless surgeries and critical care

age.details: Not specified

income.details: Starting July 1, 2024, the scheme covers all families in Maharashtra (no income limit)

location: 865 villages of Belgaon, Karwar, Kalburgi and Bidar Districts of Maharashtra-Karnataka border
otherConditions: Must possess Orange, Yellow, Antyodaya, or Annapurna ration card, or a White ration card (for the 14 agriculturally distressed districts), or have active registration with the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Category B includes White ration card holders and families without ration cards having domicile certificates of Maharashtra

Category C includes students in government-recognized Ashram schools/orphanages, women in government-recognized Ashrams, senior citizens in recognized old age homes, journalists, and registered construction workers from outside Maharashtra
Category D includes road traffic accident victims from outside Maharashtra or India who met with an accident on roads in Maharashtra
Category E includes families holding AAY, PHH, or Annapurna ration cards from the border districts

benefits: Cashless medical treatment up to ₹1,50,000/- per family per policy year in empanelled hospitals (increased to ₹2,50,000/- for renal transplants)
From July 2024, integrated with AB-PMJAY to offer up to ₹5,00,000/- in total annual coverage for Categories A, B, C, and E
For Category D, provides ₹1,00,000/- per person per year for road accident treatments (184 health packages)
Includes hemodialysis (8 to 12 cycles per pre-auth) covering consultations, diagnostics, consumable dialyzers, tubings, needles, and medicines
Covers bed charges, nursing, consultants' fees, diagnostic tests, food, and one-time transport cost back to residence (or deceased body transport in the event of death)
schemes.officialSource:
Public Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Maharashtra

## CATEGORY B: CONDITIONALLY RELEVANT
Schemes that could be useful to some OnShift workers but require additional characteristics such as age, gender, occupation, social category, disability, rural/urban residence, specific registration, employment type, or other conditions

schemes.name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
schemes.description: Helps mobile barbers, on-demand laundry partners, or street hawkers secure collateral-free capital to expand businesses

age.details: Age Limit: There is no age limit to apply

location: Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) in all States and Union Territories
Surrounding development/peri-urban/rural areas vending within ULB limits
otherConditions: Must possess Certificate of Vending (CoV) or ULB-issued ID Card, or be identified in a ULB survey, or possess a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) issued by the ULB/Town Vending Committee (TVC)

st Tranche:** Loan up to ₹10,000 or ₹15,000 (repayment in 12 months)
nd Tranche:** Loan up to ₹20,000 or ₹25,000 (repayment in 18 months).
rd Tranche:** Loan up to ₹50,000 (repayment in 36 months)
Timely/early repayment unlocks higher tranches with no prepayment penalty
Interest subsidy on timely/early repayment @ 7% per annum
Monthly digital transaction cashback incentives from ₹50/- up to ₹100/-
documents: For First Loan: Certificate of Vending or ULB Identity Card (for Categories A & B)
or Letter of Recommendation (for Categories C & D)
KYC Documents: Aadhaar Card (Voter ID Card for Assam/Meghalaya)
For Second Loan: Loan Closure Document

benefits: PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card
Basic Training of 5-7 days and optional Advanced Training of 15 days with ₹500/- daily stipend
Toolkit Incentive: ₹15,000/- grant

Collateral-free Enterprise Development Loans up to ₹1,00,000 (First Tranche, 18-month repayment) and ₹2,00,000 (Second Tranche, 30-month repayment) at a concessional interest rate of 5%, with 8% interest subvention
Digital transaction incentives: ₹1 per transaction (up to 100 transactions monthly)
documents: Aadhaar cards of all family members)

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY 2.0)

income.details: Net family income is less than ₹8 Lakh per annum

otherConditions: Pregnant woman or lactating mother

Eligible beneficiary can apply within 270 days from the child birth

Applicant must belong to a socially and economically disadvantaged category (SC/ST, BPL Card holder, PMJAY beneficiary, female e-Shram cardholder, Kisan Samman Nidhi beneficiary, MGNREGA Job Card holder, or net family income less than ₹8 Lakh per annum)
exclusions: In regular employment with the Central/State Governments, PSUs, or in receipt of similar maternity benefits under any other law

benefits: First Child:** Cash incentive of ₹5,000/- in two installments:
₹3,000/- on registration and at least one ANC checkup within 6 months of LMP
₹2,000/- post-childbirth registration and immunization
Average benefit of ₹6,000/- is achieved when JSY cash incentive is added post institutional delivery
Second Child (if a girl):** A single cash transfer of ₹6,000/- post-birth after child registration and 14-week vaccinations

MCP/RCHI card showing LMP and ANC dates

schemes.name: NAMO Shree Scheme (Gujarat)

targetWorkerTypes: Pregnant women and lactating mothers of Gujarat

benefits: Financial assistance of ₹12,000/- for the first two live children, distributed in phases from conception to delivery
First Pregnancy Disbursal:** ₹5,000/- at registration; ₹2,000/- after 6 months; ₹3,000/- after institutional delivery; ₹2,000/- after the 14-week vaccination

Second Pregnancy Disbursal:** ₹2,000/- at registration; ₹3,000/- after 6 months; ₹6,000/- after institutional delivery (from Central Govt if a girl, from State if a boy); ₹1,000/- after the 14-week vaccination
Eligible to concurrently avail benefits of central schemes like PMMVY and JSY
documents: and Certificate from Medical Institution of Delivery (for last installment)
schemes.officialSource: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Gujarat

benefits: Free LPG connection with cash assistance of ₹1,600 (for 14.2kg cylinder) / ₹1,150 (for 5 kg cylinder)
Covers Security Deposit of Cylinder (₹1,250 / ₹800), Pressure Regulator (₹150), LPG Hose (₹100), Domestic Gas Consumer Card (₹25), and installation/demonstration charges (₹75)
